ac_implies_lipschitz_V_approx: AC functions are V-limits of Lipschitz functions
sorry_details.sorry_reason: Two sorry boundaries: (1) Reverse direction: Lipschitz functions are AC (proven zero-sorry via LipschitzOnWith.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval), and V-convergence preserves AC. The preservation step requires connecting eVariationOn to sums of absolute differences on disjoint intervals plus the epsilon-delta characterization of AC. (2) Forward direction: AC implies f' exists a.e. and is integrable (FTC), truncation g_n = clamp(f',-n,n) gives Lipschitz antiderivatives, V(f_n-f) = integral|g_n-f'| -> 0 by DCT. Each step uses deep Mathlib API.
